summary: Build a website for an AI chatbot brand named KairoNova (ChatGPT-like) developed by Kairav.

existing_features.title: Create a coherent KairoNova brand identity across the website, including a consistent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a premium AI chatbot brand; avoid blue/purple as primary colors.

Implement a public Landing page for the KairoNova chatbot brand that clearly presents: product name “KairoNova”, tagline, brief description, and creator attribution “Developed by Kairav”, with calls-to-action that navigate to the Chat experience.

Implement a Chat page that provides a ChatGPT-like UI (message list, user input box, send button, loading indicator) and supports an on-chain demo chatbot response flow without using any external AI/LLM APIs (e.g., simple rules-based responses, canned replies, or scripted behaviors).

Add basic informational pages and navigation: About (describing KairoNova and attribution to Kairav), and Privacy/Disclaimer (stating this is a demo chatbot experience and does not provide professional advice).

Use React Query for chat data flow (loading history, sending messages, receiving bot replies) with appropriate loading/error UI states so the chat remains responsive and failures are visible to the user.
Add basic SEO/accessibility essentials: meaningful page titles, semantic headings, and keyboard-accessible chat input controls.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create the KairoNova AI chatbot website (branding + site pages)

Implement backend persistence in the single Motoko actor to store and retrieve chat sessions/messages for the current user/device context (simple session model is acceptable), and expose canister methods consumed by the frontend via the existing actor hook pattern.
